results.title: Groomed: A National Scandal
results.overview: Five young women who survived unimaginable abuse and rape tell their stories of a gang grooming spanning 20 years. Failures of police and social services continue to this day.

results.title: Marindia
results.overview: Elisa returns to her home in Marindia after learning that her warehouse has been broken into and robbed. Mauricio accompanies her. With a hidden sense of hope, they share a day that oscillates between memories, questions, and disagreements. Without leaving a zone of nostalgic warmth, they try to give another chance to a relationship that can't find a way to end.

results.title: Surviving Ohio State
results.overview: Delves into the sexual abuse scandal surrounding athletics doctor Richard Strauss, whose two-decade tenure at The Ohio State University saw the abuse of hundreds of students, and the ongoing quest for justice and accountability by his survivors.

results.title: The Librarians
results.overview: As an unprecedented wave of book banning is sparked in Texas, Florida, and beyond, librarians under siege join forces as unlikely defenders fighting for intellectual freedom on the front lines of democracy.

results.title: Reminiscence
results.overview: Aurora, daughter of retired Jazz composer Hugo, is informed that his father’s Alzheimer’s disease has worsened significantly. She will use their memories together and the music they composed in order to try to get him to recognize her one last time before he moves permanently abroad to continue fighting his disease.

results.title: The North
results.overview: A decade after they were best friends and roommates, Chris and Lluis set out on a 600 kilometer hike through the Scottish Highlands to reconnect with each other, nature and parts of themselves they lost.

results.title: Dino Birds
results.overview: Fossils reveal how birds survived the killer asteroid and became today's only living dinosaurs.

results.title: Prey for the Bride
results.overview: A group of friends at a bachelorette party are stalked, tortured and murdered by a masked figure, who forces them to face a long-buried secret.

results.title: Arruinarlo todo (o la noche que nos prometimos)
results.original_title: Arruinarlo todo (o la noche que nos prometimos)
results.overview: Adriana and Mariana go on a road trip in which they will take the Aaron test, a 36-question questionnaire designed to make two strangers fall in love.

results.title: The Legend of Nigel Kneale: The Creeping Unknown
results.original_title: The Legend of Nigel Kneale: The Creeping Unknown
results.overview: Who was Nigel Kneale? Toby Hadoke investigates the man and his influence

results.title: Windward
results.overview: Filmed on Fogo Island, Windward unfolds across the landscape—its distinctive geological formations, climate, and austere beauty—through delicate portrayals of youth.

results.title: The Father, The Sons and The Holy Spirit
results.overview: Brothers Henrik and Christian have put a year-long family and inheritance dispute behind them. A dispute that was once about a million-dollar fortune and a dubious will, but which was fundamentally rooted in their shared upbringing in a dysfunctional family. Now the two brothers stand at a crossroads: Henrik tries to break the destructive patterns and create stability for his family, while Christian seeks belonging in a right-wing brotherhood. At the center is Henrik's son Alexander, torn between the shadows of the past and his own hope for change. Can one ever break free from one's social heritage?

results.title: Ablaze
results.overview: Karine and Jimmy are a close-knit couple, still deeply in love after twenty years together and two children. She works in a factory; he is a truck driver striving to grow his small business. When the Yellow Vests movement emerges, Karine is swept up by the power of the collective, the anger, and the hope for change. But as her commitment intensifies, the couple’s balance begins to falter.

results.title: Can you hear me?
results.overview: A middle-aged Chinese couple, illegal immigrants in the U.S. who do not speak English, must find a way to communicate with Americans and handle their daughter’s body after discovering her dead at home.

results.title: Be a Good Girl
results.overview: In an isolated house up in the mountains, Anne leads a strange and obedient life alongside Edgar. Lately, however, she has grown too old for her husband's liking. Determined to replace her, he kidnaps a teenager and brings her home. The girl becomes Edgar's new obsession, setting in motion a twisted game of control and survival, one in which Anne is going to have to decide between protecting the girl or preserving the life she knows.

results.title: A Model Boyfriend
results.overview: Mallory goes on a date with a strange man named Claude.

results.title: The Truth About Jussie Smollett?
results.overview: The shocking true story of an allegedly fake story that some now say might just be a true story. With first-hand interviews from those at the helm, including investigating police, lawyers, journalists and Jussie himself, this compelling documentary invites the audience to decide for themselves who is telling The Truth About Jussie Smollett?

results.title: La pire mère au monde
results.overview: Louise de Pileggi, a brilliant assistant district attorney, has always had a complicated relationship with her mother, Judith, whom she hasn’t seen in 15 years. When she is transferred to the small courthouse where Judith works as a court clerk, Louise becomes her mother’s boss. And worse still: they will have to work together on a case that seems trivial at first glance, but which will put their nerves on edge.
